_comment: Raptor's egg library (library/README.md). Written for Raptor.
name: frp
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: frp is a fast reverse proxy that exposes servers behind a NAT or firewall. Runs frps, the server that frp clients connect to with a shared token.
startup: if [ -z "${FRPS_TOKEN:-}" ]; then echo "Set Auth token in the server's settings first: without one, anyone could use this server."; exit 1; fi; exec ./frps -c frps.toml

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# frp: downloads frps (the server half of frp) from its GitHub releases,
# checked against GitHub's SHA-256, and writes a first frps.toml. An
# existing frps.toml is never touched.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
work=/mnt/server/.raptor-build
rm -rf "$work" && mkdir -p "$work"
trap 'rm -rf "$work"' EXIT
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }

case "$(uname -m)" in
    x86_64) arch=amd64 ;;
    aarch64) arch=arm64 ;;
    *) fail "frp has no build for this CPU ($(uname -m))." ;;
esac

want="${VERSION:-latest}"
[ "$want" = latest ] || want="v${want#v}"
tag=$(gh-release tag fatedier/frp "$want") || fail "Set Version to latest, or to a release such as 0.72.0, then reinstall."
version="${tag#v}"

if [ -x frps ] && [ "$(cat .frps-version 2>/dev/null)" = "$tag" ]; then
    echo "frps $version is already installed."
else
    echo "Downloading frps $version"
    gh-release download fatedier/frp "$tag" "frp_${version}_linux_${arch}.tar.gz" "$work/frp.tar.gz"
    tar -xzf "$work/frp.tar.gz" -C "$work" --strip-components=1
    install -m 0755 "$work/frps" frps.new
    mv -f frps.new frps
    echo "$tag" > .frps-version
fi

# The port and token come from the server's settings at every start (frp
# reads them from the environment); everything else is the owner's to change.
if [ ! -f frps.toml ]; then
    cat > frps.toml <<'TOML'
# frps settings: https://github.com/fatedier/frp#configuration-files
# The port clients connect to and the token they need come from the
# server's settings. Clients can open proxies on the server's other ports.
bindAddr = "0.0.0.0"
bindPort = {{ .Envs.SERVER_PORT }}
auth.method = "token"
auth.token = "{{ .Envs.FRPS_TOKEN }}"

# Only these ports can be opened by clients (add the server's other ports).
# allowPorts = [{ start = 25565, end = 25570 }]

# Web dashboard: set a port the server has and a password to turn it on.
# webServer.addr = "0.0.0.0"
# webServer.port = 7500
# webServer.user = "admin"
# webServer.password = ""
TOML
    echo "Wrote a first frps.toml."
fi
echo "Installed frps $version."

variables.name: Version
variables.description: The frp version to install, such as 0.72.0, or latest. Reinstall to change it.

variables.name: Auth token
variables.description: The token frp clients must use to connect (auth.token in frpc.toml). The server won't start without one.
